# Kay v2 Reference (for humans & coding agents)

> Kay v2 is a Bun-native TSX web framework with zero-directive automatic islands, `.value` fine-grained signals, flat-string SSR, unified Standard-Schema actions, single-binary `--compile`, and a composable `KayPlugin` API.

## Core Rules (everything fits on one page)

- **Standard TSX & compiler guardrails**: `.tsx` files with `jsxImportSource: "kay"`. Use `class` or `className` (never both). Standard `.map()` (with `key={...}`), `&&`, ternaries, `{...spread}`, SVG elements, style strings or objects (`style={{ color: 'red' }}`), and CSS / `*.module.css` imports work natively. Compiler/runtime refuse common React/Solid/Astro habits: `innerHTML={html}` takes a string or `raw(html)` (never `{ __html }`, never `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`, never on void elements or with children); events are camelCase DOM names (`onClick`, `onDblClick`, `onKeyDown` — never lowercase `onclick`, `on:click`, `onDoubleClick`, `*Capture`, string handlers, or render-time assignments); `ref` is always a callback `ref={el => ...}` (never `{ current }`); SVG attrs use kebab-case (`stroke-width`, `fill-opacity`); use `value`/`checked` (not `defaultValue`/`defaultChecked`) and boolean `{false}` (not `"false"`); no `client:*`/`use:*`/`class:list`/`set:html` directives; no Promises, functions, signals, or plain objects in JSX text/attrs. Spreads drop `on*`, `innerHTML`, `srcdoc`, and `javascript:`/`vbscript:` URLs.
- **Signals (`kay`)**: `const count = signal(0)` (`.value` read/write, `.peek()` untracked), `computed(() => ...)`, `effect(() => ...)` (return cleanup), `batch(() => ...)`, `untrack(() => ...)`, `root(dispose => ...)`, `onMount(() => ...)` (runs after DOM attach; return cleanup), `onCleanup(() => ...)`, `getOwner()`, `selector(() => id.value)` (O(1) selection), `store(obj)` + `snapshot(s)`. To let a child mutate parent state, pass the signal directly (`<Modal open={isOpen} />`).
- **Reactive props**: Destructuring props (`function Badge({ count = 0, ...rest }: Props)`) stays reactive in client components; server-rendered children inside islands are preserved via `<kay-slot>`.
- **Automatic islands**: Any component using reactive primitives (`signal`, `computed`, `effect`, `onMount`, `store`, `selector`), DOM `on*` handlers/`ref`, or imported reactive module state becomes an island automatically. Control hydration per call site with `$hydrate="load" | "visible" | "idle" | "interaction" | "media(...)" | "client"`, or component default `island(Comp, { hydrate: 'visible' })` (unknown modes and `$hydrate` on non-islands fail compile). Island props crossing the server boundary must be serializable (JSON primitives + `Date`, `Map`, `Set`, `URL`, `RegExp` — functions and signals are refused). Islands cannot import server-only modules (`bun:sqlite`, `node:*`, `kay/server`) or read `process.env` other than `process.env.PUBLIC_*` (inlined at build time); action files are stubbed on the client (non-action exports from them cannot be imported by islands).
- **Routes (`src/routes/`)**:
  - `export default async function Page({ params, locals, url })`: strictly server-only (`0 KB` JS; cannot use signals/handlers directly).
  - Sync `export default function Page({ data, params, locals, url })`: static or auto-island; optional `export async function load(ctx)` runs server-only and returns data or a `Response` (e.g. `404` / redirect).
  - Special files: `_layout.tsx` (nested outer→inner, receives `{ children, params, locals, url }`, server-only), `_middleware.ts` (`(ctx, next) => Response`, outer→inner), `_error.tsx` (receives `{ error }`, server-only, wrapped in root layout), `_404.tsx` (server-only, wrapped in root layout, also emitted as `404.html` in `--static`).
  - Params: `[slug].tsx` → `params.slug`; `[...path].tsx` → `params.path`.
  - API routes: `.ts` files exporting `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE` receiving `RequestContext` (`request`, `url`, `params`, `cookies`, `locals`, `ip`, `json()`, `text()`, `redirect()`, `deny()`). Optional `export const csrf = false` opts out of origin checks (e.g. webhooks/bearer APIs).
  - Prerendering: `export const prerender = true` (+ `export function paths() { return ['/posts/a'] }` required for dynamic routes; unlisted params return `404`). Skipped in `kay dev`.
- **Streaming & Head**: `<Head><title>...</title></Head>` (innermost `<title>` wins); `<Suspense fallback={<p>Loading</p>} error={<p>Failed</p>}><AsyncComp /></Suspense>` streams resolved HTML inline with 0 KB external JS (takes exactly one child; nested boundaries supported; times out after `streamTimeout`, default `30000` ms; errors also fire `onError`).
- **Actions (`kay/server`)**: `export const fn = action(standardSchema, async (input, ctx) => ..., options?)` or `action(async (ctx) => ...)` — must be a top-level named export so Kay can assign a URL. Works as zero-JS `<form action={fn} method="post">` (array fields auto-coerced from checkboxes/multi-selects; validation failures set an `HttpOnly` flash cookie readable via `getActionError(ctx.locals)` with sensitive fields stripped or `flashFields` allowlisted and `303` redirect to trusted Referer) and as typed island RPC `const res = await fn(data)` (always resolves to `{ ok: true, data }` or `{ ok: false, status, error, fieldErrors?, issues? }`; accepts `FormData` for files; redirects navigate the page). Server code is stripped from client bundles; CSRF `Origin`/`Sec-Fetch-Site` is checked before middleware and body parsing; folder `_middleware.ts` runs before the handler. `ctx` provides `redirect()` and `deny(status, message, fieldErrors?)`.
- **Config & Security (`kay.config.ts`, `kay/server`)**: `defineConfig({ lang, port, routesDir, outDir, publicDir, assetPrefix, security, trustedOrigins, trustProxy, maxRequestBodySize, streamTimeout, compress, onError, plugins })`. Default security headers (`security: false` to disable, or override `csp`, `hsts`, `frameOptions`, `referrerPolicy`, `contentTypeOptions`) attach strict `DEFAULT_CSP` with automatic SHA-256 hashes for island/Suspense styles and stream scripts, plus `HSTS` on HTTPS requests. `trustProxy: true | number` trusts that many right-most proxy hops for `X-Forwarded-*`. `maxRequestBodySize` defaults to `1 MiB`. `defineEnv(standardSchema)` validates env vars at startup; `nodeEnv()` reads `NODE_ENV` at runtime (safe in `--compile`).
- **Static files & CSS**: Files in `public/` are served at `/` with ETag/`304` (and `Cache-Control: no-cache` in `kay dev`; embedded in `--static` and `--compile`). Import `.css` or `*.module.css` directly from any component or layout.
- **CLI**: `kay new <dir> [--template minimal|fullstack|blog|app] [--force]`, `kay check [dir] [--no-typecheck]`, `kay dev [dir] [--port 3000] [--host [addr]]` (loopback `127.0.0.1` default), `kay build [dir] [--static] [--compile [out]] [--analyze]`, `kay start [dir] [--port 3000] [--host [addr]]`, plus plugin commands (`kay ui-eject <grammar> [dest]`, `kay mcp-footprint`, `kay i18n-check`).
- **Testing (`kay/test`)**: `const app = await testApp({ root, prebuilt? })` — in-process `app.get()`, `app.post()`, `app.submit(actionUrl, fields)`, `app.fetch()`, `app.cookies`, `app.clearCookies()` with persistent cookie jar and zero port binding.
- **Plugins (`kay.config.ts`)**: `export default defineConfig({ plugins: [...] })` / `definePlugin(...)`.
  - Hooks: `server(api)` (`use`, `route(method, path, handler, { csrf?, trustedOrigins?, trustProxy? })`, `rewrite`, `provide`, `inject`, `getBuildData`), `onError(info)`, `build(ctx)` (`emitAsset`, `emitPublic`, `addStyle`, `addRouteStyle`, `addHead`, `addRouteHead`, `provide`, `inject`, `setData`, `routes`), `afterPrerender(ctx)` (`routes`, `publicFiles`, `emitAsset`, `emitPublic`, `setData`), `transform`, `bunPlugins` (array or `({ root, assetPrefix, minify, target }) => [...]`), `css`, `transformHtml`, `prerenderPaths`, `clientEntry`, `check(ctx)`, `watchPaths`, `commands`.
  - First-party packages (13 total with `@kayjs/kay`):
    - `@kayjs/ui`: Platform-first headless primitives (`Stack`, `Cluster`, `Grid`, `Sidebar`, `Split`, `Button`, `Card`, `Badge`, `Notice`, `Field`, `Switch`, `Checkbox`, `RadioGroup`, `Accordion`, `Popover`, `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `Tabs`, `Menu`, `Select`, `CommandPalette`, `DataTable`, `Toaster` + `toast()`) & pure CSS `@layer kui` Style Grammars (`orbit`, `editorial`, `workshop`, `console`, `soft`, `bare`); `kay ui-eject <grammar> [dest]`.
    - `@kayjs/auth`: Argon2id passwords, hashed DB sessions, email verification (`requireEmailVerification: true` default), magic links (first claim drops prior password/sessions/OAuth links), OAuth 2.0 + PKCE (`github()`, `discord()`, `google()`, `oauthProvider()`), `auth.guard()`, `site` required off localhost, IP+email rate limiting (`trustProxy`), RGPD helpers (`listSessions`, `exportUser`, `deleteUser`, `pruneExpired`, `storeIp`, `storeUserAgent`), `memoryAuthStore()` & `sqliteAuthStore()` (`bun:sqlite`).
    - `@kayjs/content`: Zero-dep `Bun.markdown` + `Bun.YAML` nested frontmatter + Standard Schema, lazy memoized Markdown rendering (`await entry.render()`) + O(1) `get(slug)`, `highlight(code, lang)` hook (Shiki-ready), MDX-lite embedded TSX `components`, `headingLinks`, auto-wired `@kayjs/images` optimization (`resolveImage: false` to opt out), localized collections (`localized: true`), TOC, and RSS feeds (`contentPlugin`).
    - `@kayjs/live`: Typed SSE rooms (`createRooms`), microtask-coalesced presence (`coalescePresence`), `useLive()` browser signal hook.
    - `@kayjs/mcp`: Opt-in MCP Streamable HTTP (`2025-03-26`) plugin exposing typed `action()` handlers & compacted Standard JSON Schema tools (strips coercion branches, `x-*`, no-op bounds, folds homogeneous records) at `/mcp/tools` with bearer auth (`404` unconfigured, `401` invalid), `schemas`+`schemaRef` (`describe_schema`), `resources`, `format`/`formatResult`, `pruneEmpty`, `maxOutputChars`, `annotations`, `formatLines`/`formatTable`, `budget` warnings in dev/`kay check`, and `kay mcp-footprint` / `inspectMcpFootprint()`.
    - `@kayjs/images`: Build-time AVIF/WebP pipeline + disk cache (`images()`, `image()`, `<Picture>`, `optimizeImageFile()`) + 1200×630 OG PNG `shareCard()`.
    - `@kayjs/seo`: `titleTemplate`, localized `description`, multi-favicon, OG/Twitter/JSON-LD, `sitemap.xml` (`extraUrls`), redirects, self-hosted fonts (`@fontsource/*`).
    - `@kayjs/i18n`: Locale URL rewriting (`ctx.locals.locale`/`t`/`localize`/`alternates`), `<html lang>` + internal link prefixing (`data-no-localize` opt-out), `prerenderPaths` expansion, `hreflang` alternates, `localizePath()`, `alternateLinks()`, `formatDate()`, `formatNumber()`, automatic `kay check` + `kay i18n-check`.
    - `@kayjs/icons`: Virtual `~icons/<set>/<name>` inline SVG imports + `<Icon>`.
    - `@kayjs/mail`: `mailer()`, `resend()` HTTP transport (auto-uses `RESEND_API_KEY`), custom transports, `mailPlugin(mail)` dev-only `/_kay/mail` (+ `.json`) outbox preview (never mounted in production).
    - `@kayjs/tailwind`: Tailwind v4 via `tailwind()` (auto-loads `bun-plugin-tailwind`, defaults `css: 'src/app.css'`).
    - `@kayjs/spa`: Opt-in SPA navigation (`spa()`) with `[data-persist]` islands, `data-no-spa` opt-out, `[data-kay-prefetch]` hover prefetch, head/style diffing, and focus/live-region announcements.
- **Server builds & `--compile`**: Server `Bun.build` keeps npm dependencies external (`packages: 'external'`) while compiling `kay` / `@kayjs/*` TSX packages; `kay build --compile` bundles everything + `public/` assets (`with { type: "file" }`) into one standalone Bun executable (`NODE_ENV` defaults to `production`).
